name: Angels Landing
quote: Along this 5.4 mile round-trip hike, you will gain 1,488 feet in elevation. Most hikers take around 4 hours to complete the hike
why: Permit-only chained route along a knife-edge ridge above Zion Canyon, via the West Rim Trail from The Grotto.

name: The Narrows (via Riverside Walk)
quote: The Narrows | Up to 8 hrs | 9.4 mi / 15.1km | 334 ft / 102 m | Out and back hike.
why: Bottom-up wade up the Virgin River slot canyon from the end of the Riverside Walk.

name: Watchman Trail
quote: Watchman trail is 3.3 miles (5.3 km) roundtrip. On average, it takes about 2 hours to complete.
why: Out-and-back from the Visitor Center climbing to a viewpoint of the Watchman, lower Zion Canyon and Springdale.

name: Middle Emerald Pools Trail
quote: Middle Emerald Pools is 2.2 miles (3.5 km) roundtrip (out-and-back).
why: Unpaved climb from Zion Lodge to a sandstone ledge with pools above Lower Emerald Pool.

name: Lower Emerald Pool Trail
quote: Lower Emerald Pool Trail | 1 hour | 1.2 mi / 1.9 km | 150 ft / 46 m
why: Mostly paved trail from Zion Lodge under the Middle Emerald Pools to the Lower Emerald Pool.

name: Upper Emerald Pool Trail
quote: Upper Emerald Pool Trail | 1 hour | 1 mi / 1.6 km | 200 ft / 61 m
why: Sandy, rocky climb to the Upper Emerald Pool at the base of a cliff.

name: Canyon Overlook Trail
quote: Roundtrip Distance: 1.0 mi / 1.6 km Elevation Change: 163 ft / 50 m Estimated Hiking Time: 1 hour
why: Short rocky trail on the east side of the tunnel to a fenced viewpoint over lower Zion Canyon.

name: Scout Lookout via West Rim Trail
quote: Scout Lookout via West Rim Trail | 3 hours | 4.2 mi / 6.2 km | 1000 ft / 305 m
why: Switchbacking West Rim climb from The Grotto through Walter's Wiggles to the start of the Angels Landing chains (no permit needed).

name: Riverside Walk
quote: Riverside Walk | 1.5 hours | 2.2 mi / 3.5 km | 57 ft / 17 m
why: Paved riverside path from the Temple of Sinawava to the start of The Narrows.

name: Pa’rus Trail
quote: Pa’rus Trail | 2 hours | 3.5 mi / 5.6 km | 50 ft / 15 m
why: Paved multi-use path along the Virgin River from the Visitor Center to Canyon Junction.

name: East Mesa Trail to Observation Point
quote: Distance (roundtrip): 6 miles (9.6 km) to the East Rim Trail and back. 6.8 miles (11 km) to Observation Point and back.
why: Forest walk from the East Mesa trailhead (4WD access) to Observation Point; the only current route there.

name: Kayenta Trail
quote: Kayenta Trail | 1.5 hours | 2 mi / 3.2 km | 150 ft / 46 m
why: Unpaved climb from The Grotto with canyon views, joining the Emerald Pools trails.

name: Sand Bench Trail
quote: Sand Bench Trail | 3 hours | 4 mi / 6.4 km | 466 ft / 142 m
why: Hike from Court of the Patriarchs onto an ancient landslide below The Sentinel; also a horse trail.

name: Taylor Creek Trail
quote: Taylor Creek Trail | 3.5 hours | 5.0 mi / 8.0 km | 450 ft / 137 m
why: Kolob Canyons hike up the Middle Fork of Taylor Creek past homestead cabins to Double Arch Alcove.

name: Kolob Arch via La Verkin Creek Trail
quote: Kolob Arch via La Verkin Creek Trail | 8 hours | 14 mi / 22.5 km | 1037 ft / 316 m
why: Long day hike from Lee Pass along Timber and La Verkin Creeks to one of the world's largest free-standing arches.

name: Timber Creek Overlook Trail
quote: Timber Creek Overlook Trail | 1 hour | 1 mi / 1.6 km | 100 ft / 30 m
why: Short ridge walk at the end of Kolob Canyons Road to views of Timber Creek and the Pine Valley Mountains.

name: The Grotto Trail
quote: The Grotto Trail is an easy, 1.0 mi (1.6 km) round trip hike that connects the Zion Lodge to The Grotto Picnic Area.
why: Flat, shaded walk between Zion Lodge and The Grotto.

name: Northgate Peaks Trail
quote: Distance (roundtrip): 4.2 miles / 6.8 km from the Wildcat Canyon Trailhead Elevation Change: 100 feet / 30 m Estimated Hiking Time: 2 hours roundtrip
why: Kolob Terrace walk through aspen and conifer to a viewpoint of the Northgate Peaks.

name: Hop Valley Trail
quote: Distance (roundtrip): 13.0 miles / 21 km to La Verkin Creek and back Elevation Change: 1,050 feet / 320 m Estimated Hiking Time: 6 hours roundtrip
why: Sandy Kolob Terrace trail across open country into flat-floored, walled Hop Valley down to La Verkin Creek.

name: West Rim Trail via Lava Point
quote: Distance (roundtrip): 19.0 miles / 30.6 km Elevation Change: 1,500 feet / 450 m Estimated Hiking Time: 9 hours roundtrip
why: High-rim out-and-back from Lava Point past Potato Hollow to Cabin Spring.

name: East Rim Trail
quote: Distance (one way): 5.9 miles (9.5 km) to Stave Spring and 10.6 miles (17.0 km) to Observation Point. Elevation Change: 1,000 ft / 300 m to Stave Spring Estimated Hiking Time: 6 hours roundtrip to Stave Spring
why: Climb from the East Entrance onto the plateau through ponderosa forest to Stave Spring.

name: Deertrap Mountain Trail
quote: 9.8 miles (15.8 km) from the Stave Spring Trailhead to Deertrap Mountain and back.
why: East Rim mesa hike to the edge of Deertrap Mountain with views into Zion Canyon (20.4 mi from East Rim Trailhead).

name: Cable Mountain Trail
quote: 7 miles (11.2 km) from the Stave Spring Trailhead to Cable Mountain and back.
why: Mesa hike to the historic Cable Mountain cableworks on the rim above Zion Canyon (17.6 mi from East Entrance Trailhead).
